title: Choose the visual world for the Augmented landing page
question: The roll assigned the Site Hoarding. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. All directions keep Claude's palette, the EN/FR toggle and a question-and-answer demo.

options.label: The Site Hoarding
options.lineage: printed construction hoardings and site signage around live building sites
options.thesis: The page is the hoarding around a live site, and the demo is what you see through its viewing window.
options.viewport: A clay hoarding panel with the question set at billboard scale; a round viewing window cut into it shows the 3D frame being asked and lit; the action reads as the site entrance.
options.risk: Turns into a construction costume if the signage is decoration instead of carrying real content.

raised.raise: One shouting hierarchy: the question is set enormous, the answer at half that size, and a dense small-print project board anchors the foot.
Each demo question opens and closes through the viewing window itself, like an iris, instead of cross-fading.
Answers are pinned to the elements they counted with leader lines, not floated in a card.
One clock: typing, the understood tags, the lighting of elements and the answer all land on the same beat.

regions.label: nav set into the top rail of the hoarding
question at billboard scale on a clay panel
answer pinned with a leader line + entrance action
panel seam, then the signage section below

options.label: The Studio Scale Model
options.lineage: architects' card and timber scale models photographed under studio light
options.thesis: The product is shown as a physical model on a studio table, and every answer lifts its elements out like model pieces.
options.viewport: A large model on a calm ground; a question tag hangs from a pin and the matching pieces rise out of the model.
options.risk: The closest to what this category usually ships: calm, crafted and easy to forget.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.thesis: Forces made visible: every answer traced along cords to its counterforce.
options.viewport: A breathing column with values pinned on leader lines.
options.case: Engineers identify with it, but it implies structural analysis and connections Augmented cannot compute: fails product truth.
options.risk: Promises load paths the product does not have.
options.kept: Answers pinned to their elements with leader lines.

options.label: Double-feature one-sheet
options.thesis: Two titles shouting at different scales over a collage.
options.viewport: A shouting sheet with a billing block at the foot.
options.case: AEC professionals do not identify with ballyhoo, and the hype undercuts the honesty claim.
options.risk: Reads as hype for a product that sells exactness.
options.kept: Total hierarchy commitment and a dense small-print block at the foot.

options.label: Rubber-hose animation cel
options.thesis: Every gag opens and closes through an iris.
options.viewport: A rounded scene inside an oval iris.
options.case: Playful in a field that buys precision; weak on both axes.
options.risk: Makes a precision tool look like a toy.
options.kept: Scenes that arrive through an iris.

options.label: Drum-machine step row
options.thesis: A sixteen-step row under a chase light.
options.viewport: A step row as the page's one unbroken line.
options.case: No link to building models; the audience would not recognise it.
options.risk: A music-gear costume on an engineering tool.

options.label: Minihompy room
options.thesis: An isometric miniature room you furnish.
options.viewport: A pastel room as the profile.
options.case: The isometric scene fits the demo, but the decorating ritual is foreign to the audience.
options.kept: The scene stays whole at every size while panels restack around it.

options.label: Chromatophore skin
options.thesis: Signals drawn directly onto a living surface.
options.viewport: A skin that changes pattern on demand.
options.case: Beautiful but unrelated to buildings or models; loses both axes.
options.kept: Signals drawn directly onto the subject, not beside it.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What AI and AEC SaaS pages ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and button beside a product screenshot, feature rows below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
